item.tib: 'od gsal rdzogs chen lta ba'i glu dbyangs skal bzang theg chen dbyar gyi lang tsho dar ba'i dga' ston rnal 'byor rkang drug dgyes pa'i mgrin ngag
item.coloph: ces 'od gsal rdzogs chen lta ba'i glu dbyangs skal bzang theg chen dbyar gyi lang 'tsho dar ba'i dga' ston/ rnal 'byor rkang drug dgyes pa'i mgrin ngag ces bya ba 'di nyid rang gi slob grogs yongs 'dzin g.yung drung blo ldan nas lha rdzas bcas 'di ltar dgos zhes yang yang bskul ma mdzad pa dang / nye bar shag rig bla ma kun bzang tshe dbang grags pa'am/ kun bzang rgyal mtshan zhes snyigs dus bslab gsum 'dzin pa gang gi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar 'phags pa de nyid nas rab dkar lha reg bcas nan cher bskul bzhin/ snyigs ma'i dge byed ming 'dzin spa rigs g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang po'am/ klong chen rig pa'i dbang phyug des rdzogs chen ye khri mtha' sel dang / shar rdza rin po ches gsungs pa'i dbyings rig mdzod sogs kyi dgos don mdor bsdus su shar mar smras pa 'di nyid la gzigs shing ngag nas brjod pas gang yang tshe 'dir snang bzhi mthar phyin nas 'pho ba chen po'i sku thob par gyur cig gu dge legs dar rgyas 'phel//
item.margin: rdzogs chen rta ba'i glu dbyangs
